title: Construct Harness v1
description: A declarative step graph over existing Choosers (packages/core/chooser.mjs, schemas via the chain compiled from it) that packages/core/harness.mjs compiles into an ordinary plan (schemas/plan.v1.json), so a bounded, user-composable n-step loop (#524) shares the same containment, approval and validator machinery as any other plan. Decided on #524 (https://github.com/thenewurbankid-web/construct/issues/524#issuecomment-5901365512): a step is named by the Chooser id it runs; `next` is the default forward edge; `onResult` is a list of conditional edges keyed on facts observed after the step's chosen flow ran (the same vocabulary a Chooser option's `requires` already uses); a back-edge (its target occurs at or before its source in `steps`) must declare `maxRepeats` so a repeat-until-pass loop is always bounded; `approval: true` inserts a human gate (an ordinary manual.task plan step) before leaving that step. No new plan step kind, executor or guardrail.

version.description: Harness schema version. Bump this file to v2 (harness.v2.json) on any breaking shape change rather than mutating v1 in place.

id.description: A plain identifier for this harness (e.g. "debug").

steps.description: The graph's nodes, in the order they are first reached by the default (`next`) walk. A back-edge may still return to an earlier node.

chooser.description: The id of an existing Chooser (defineChooser) this step runs. Also this step's own node id within the harness: unique among `steps`.

next.description: The default forward edge: another step's `chooser` id. Omit to end the walk here unless `onResult` redirects it.

onResult.description: Conditional edges, checked in order against the facts observed after this step's chosen flow ran; the first match wins over `next`.

approval.description: When true, leaving this step inserts a human approval gate (a manual.task plan step) before the next one.

when.description: A fact name; this edge is taken when it is among the facts observed after the source step ran.

next.description: Another step's `chooser` id to continue at.

maxRepeats.description: Required when `next` targets a step at or before this one in `steps` (a back-edge): the most times this edge may be taken, so a repeat-until-pass loop is always bounded.
